bull.claim: 14% order inflows growth in Q1 FY '27 is ahead of 10% to 12% target.
bull.why: Secular intake expansion secures multi-year revenue visibility and operational scale for execution.

bull.claim: 4.1% Net Working Capital to Revenue ratio as of March 2026 beat around 12% target.
bull.why: Working capital reduction releases balance sheet cash and strengthens management execution credibility.

bull.claim: +15.8% YoY Revenue and +32.5% PAT (to owners) in Q2 FY27.
bull.why: Accelerating revenue expansion and earnings growth enhance shareholder value and cash generation.

bull.claim: 1.15 Debt/equity at FY26 end (Mar 2026) improved from 1.52 at FY22 end.
bull.why: Lower leverage strengthens balance sheet solvency and creates financial flexibility for capital expenditure.

bear.claim: +11.8% YoY Revenue growth missed 15% guidance for FY26 (Apr 2025 – Mar 2026).
bear.why: Missing guidance damages management execution credibility and reveals project execution vulnerabilities.

bear.claim: 8.7% EBITDA margin in Q2 FY27 was down −1.3 pp YoY.
bear.why: Margin contraction compresses operating profitability and diminishes cash flow generation from contracts.

bear.claim: 16.1% trailing 12-month ROE for Q1 FY '27 fell from 17% in Q1 FY '26.
bear.why: Declining return on equity reflects weakening capital efficiency and suppresses shareholder returns.

bear.claim: 15 trillion prospect pie faces unrecovered input cost pressures and deferral risk in Q1 FY27.
bear.why: Input price inflation without pricing power impairs future contract margins and cash realization.
